title: CIA-UAP-D023, Briefing Notes for Mr. Walter Elder
doc_notes: This document is a CIA briefing note regarding UAP incidents near Puerto Rico in November 1964, featuring significant text degradation and illegible characters.

incidents.summary: Radar detection and visual observation of a high-speed object near Puerto Rico by USS Gyatt and an F-8 Crusader pilot.
incidents.quote: UFO was identified as a Delta shaped object about the size of a jet fighter.

incidents.summary: High-speed, high-altitude target tracked by Atlantic Fleet Weapons Range, maneuvering away from a Crusader aircraft.
incidents.quote: held a high-speed, high-altitude target which simultaneously pulled away rapidly from another Crusader aircraft
